notes_for_us: This prompt is the extent-vs-detail collision in its purest form: a continent at coastline scale and a walkable capital with a rail station in the same request. layout-intake tells me to offer the split and route P4, which I did - but the split it produces is one continent map plus 51 capital maps, and nothing in the skill lets me say 'the capitals are all the same layout with different names'. I had to invent a fifth question for it.

There is no option for a territory or province - a named region with an owner that can be captured. Nine of the fifteen genres would want one (nations, gang turf, kingdom borders, team territory) and the nearest rows are all wrong: buildzone-plot is where you build, control-zone is a capacity-limited point, district-zoned is commercial-vs-residential. This is the largest single hole this prompt hit.

spawn-teambase from Shooter was the only spawn row that could hold 'every capital contains a spawn point', and its wording is 'balanced bases at opposite ends of the map, completely shielded from enemy sniper lines' - which is actively wrong for 51 asymmetric capitals. The ID is right and the flavour text fights it.

genres has room for two but the walkable capital is not really Strategy's - a pre-built city players stroll around with a town hall and a rail station is Roleplay's settlement-static, which is where I took the segment shape from. Naming roleplay-avatar-sim second felt like over-reading a single sentence, so I left it out; flagging in case that is the wrong call.

The two-genre ceiling bit here. rpg + adventure is what the skill's own table prescribes for a Blox Fruits reference, but the prompt's combat content - swords, fighting styles, a boss per island - is Action's, and not loading Action cost me arena-lockin and any boss framing. Six identical map segments is what the segments rule produces here, and it is mostly noise: the user said 'each one has 4 islands', i.e. the seas are the same build repeated. There is no way to say 'six of these' in segments - no count, no template - so either I write six near-empty entries or I under-describe a P4 the rule says must be itemised.

notes_for_us: There is no plain spawn option. Four spawn rows exist and every one carries a competitive or theatrical assumption: opposing team bases, anti-camp shielding, a multi-lane starting grid, a curated first reveal. 'Spawn place' is one of the commonest two-word requests a user can make and it has to borrow a row from Entertainment.

Nothing in the system holds a ground surface. 'Mud' is a property of the ground over a region - so is snow, sand, gravel, ice - and it can only ship as free text in the image prompt. terrain-relief is landform, not surface.

genre-choice tells me to ask about a term I cannot parse, which is right, but 'mud gear 10plus' is one token soup containing possibly three requests. One-subject-per-question is unfollowable when the subject itself is unknown, so my question enumerates candidate readings instead - flagging in case that counts as a compound question.
